title: Manchester Airport orb
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Manchester Airport orb, about June 2024 at Manchester Airport, UK, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It says Manchester airport June 2024 sighting

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a sighting labelled as having happened at Manchester Airport in England in June 2024, described as an orb, a round glowing object in the sky. He gives few details beyond the place and date, raising it as one more example of unexplained things seen near airports.
